description: Antenas GNSS de la Red Geodésica Activa de las Islas Baleares (XGAIB) is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Gobierno de las Illes Balears. Location of reference antenna stations belonging to the Active GNSS Network of the Balearic Islands (XGAIB), managed by the Government of the Balearic Islands. These permanent stations provide real-time corrections for high-precision positioning using GPS, GLONASS and other satellite navigation systems. Coverage: Gobierno de las Illes Balears. The listing shows 2026-09-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.opendefinition.org/licenses/cc-by). It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
